SELECT a.id as activity_id, a.activity_name, a.start_time, a.end_time, a.status, a.create_time, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mall_activity_goods ag WHERE ag.activity_id = a.id) as goods_count, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ag.sold_count), 0) FROM mall_activity_goods ag WHERE ag.activity_id = a.id) as total_sold FROM mall_activity a
AND a.activity_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{activityName}, '%')
AND a.status = #{status}
ORDER BY a.create_time DESC

SELECT ag.id as activityGoodsId, ag.spec_id, s.goods_id as goodsId, g.goods_name, s.weight, ag.original_price, ag.activity_price, ag.activity_stock, ag.sold_count, ag.limit_per_user, ag.create_time FROM mall_activity_goods ag INNER JOIN mall_goods_spec s ON ag.spec_id = s.id INNER JOIN mall_goods g ON s.goods_id = g.id WHERE ag.activity_id = #{activityId} ORDER BY ag.create_time ASC
